items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: That's a Pete Rayfield, he got one leg on. He'd do all the fella. I used to like him.

ctx.x: I'd like to see that. Plennifeld is dead. Paggio is dead. Lange is dead. Yeah, I knew him. Ridd is dead. You know Ridd the bass player? Yeah, sure. Joseph Clark. Yeah, classic.
One of the first bands. Yeah. You know Pete Redfield? Yeah. Yeah.
